thread:
ash: Quick sync after stand: Field wants a small, safe path for private deploy upgrades that preserves egress IPs for customers. Can we define an alpha?

marie: Keep alpha minimal: no BGP, use operator-managed NAT pinning with clear caveats. Two install modes: `relay` and `pinned-egress`.

tom: Agree. Alpha acceptance: 1) rebind same egress IP after control-plane restart; 2) docs + CLI; 3) two pilot customers validated for 48h.

field-raj: Pilots will accept short maintenance windows. Need dry-run before cutover so we can validate binding.

ash: Add `rictl upgrade --dry-run` and a reconciliation metric shown in Console. If dry-run fails, abort and surface logs.

marie: Ops constraints: some clouds may reclaim IPs on replacement. We'll add a warning and detect reclaim early.

qa-bot: QA checklist created: cold restart, staged upgrade, node replacement, simulated IP reclaim.

tom: Est: 2.5 weeks engineering + 1 week docs/field. Ship opt-in alpha to <=6 customers.

field-raj: I'll collect pilot contacts and run rollback drills.

ash: I'll draft the PRD addendum with acceptance criteria and CLI examples by EOD. Everyone ok with that plan?

marie: :+1: ship alpha with prominent "not GA" notice and caveats.

tom: Filing ticket PROD-5102 for alpha pinned-egress work and linking pilots.

ash: Thanks — closing loop.
